steps.code:
# The note lists songs and artists, with some already having a release month (RELEASED_AT MM/YYYY) and others marked as TODO.
# Let's extract the songs with TODO, so we can look up their release months using the Spotify API.
import re

note_content = note["content"]
# Find all lines with RELEASED_AT TODO
todo_lines = [line for line in note_content.split('\n') if "RELEASED_AT TODO" in line]

# Extract song titles and artists from these lines
todo_songs = []
for line in todo_lines:
    # Example line: "- Tangled Lies BY Ava Morgan RELEASED_AT TODO"
    match = re.match(r"- (.+) BY (.+) RELEASED_AT TODO", line)
    if match:
        title = match.group(1).strip()
        artists = [artist.strip() for artist in match.group(2).split(",")]
        todo_songs.append({"title": title, "artists": artists})

print(todo_songs)
